headlines.text: 2026 brought us this moment: The Brawling Birds touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.30.
On this day in 2026, Castagnoli & Garcia announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.16 ? a solid showing.

Turning the clock back to 2026: Kyle Fletcher vs. Robbie Eagles clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 7.16 ? a good, competitive contest. Robbie Eagles was challenging for gold for the very first time. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
